answers.label: Cover Letter
answers.value: AI Hub's hard part looks like the one I keep running into: an extraction is only useful if you can tell when it's wrong. In DeepDoc I built a 36-case eval harness that separates indexing, retrieval and generation failures, and in Hireflow a validator rejects any LLM output that isn't in the source data, so the model can't invent a field. At poiro.com I built the node and group system for an AI workflow builder, where groups run as sub-workflows. I graduated from IIIT Nagpur in 2026, can work from Bengaluru, and can start on 23 November.
